whyItMatters: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a plugin whose `skip` configuration is true.
actions: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a plugin whose `skip` configuration is true.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm pom.xml no longer carries a plugin whose `skip` configuration is true.
